title: 6-Hour Sparkling Wine Tour of Napa Valley
includes: Private tour (Vehicle is not shared with anyone else)
Concierge Assistance (for groups of 6 or less people)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Extra time is available upon request and billed at regular hourly rate
Your payment information will be required prior to scheduled tour for standard gratuity charges
COVID-19: All wineries require reservations, please contact us as soon as possible for assistance (for groups up to 6 people). If you have more than six people please contact wineries directly)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Visit world renown Sparkling Wine vineyards and enjoy tasting of their current release and other vintage year wines. It is a private tour just for you and your group only. Private, luxury sedan is operated by a professorial, knowledgeable chauffeur who will make your wine country day relaxed and enjoyable.
